description: This file defines the 'UserProfile' interface within the 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.profile' package. It declares several methods related to user profile functionalities such as checking if a logger data item is contained, selected on various tabs, and retrieving data convertor, bytes, and protocol information.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: An interface defining user profile-related methods for ECU data handling within the RomRaider project.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the logger data is contained within the user profile.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the dash tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Retrieves the data convertor associated with the logger data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing the user profile data.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol string associated with the user profile.
